answer: Before a newcomer can trade, it must build standing in the onyx ledger: each verified job, signed with its device key, sends a ripple through the record, adding standing that halves weekly, so only recent honest work counts. Verifiers check its last three jobs and their signatures in a day. A copied job or borrowed signature voids the entry and bars the device for a cycle. One honest newcomer earns standing with three real jobs; a thousand fakes drifting through the meadow empty-handed would need three thousand verified jobs, all rotting away.
